content_of_post_to_answer: Can a person truly change, or do they simply learn to control their behavior?
answer: People often confuse change with control. A person can suppress a behavior for years without changing the beliefs, fears, or needs that created it. Real change is not becoming someone who never feels anger, insecurity, or temptation; it is when those impulses no longer define the choices you make. The deepest transformation happens when the inner reason behind a behavior changes, not just the behavior itself.
